headword: スーパー{銭湯|せんとう}
gloss: super bathhouse; large public bath complex

definitions.gloss: super bathhouse; large public bath complex
definitions.explanation: A large-scale public bathing facility that offers various types of baths, saunas, and amenities beyond a traditional public bath, often including restaurants and relaxation areas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧スーパー{銭湯|せんとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go to the super bathhouse on weekends.

examples.japanese: スーパー{銭湯|せんとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{過|す}ごした→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: I spent a relaxing time at the super bathhouse.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧スーパー{銭湯|せんとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{岩盤浴|がんばんよく}→岩盤浴：09832_ganbanyoku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This super bathhouse also has a hot stone bath.

notes:
スーパー{銭湯|せんとう} is popular in Japan as an affordable alternative to hot spring resorts. Many offer ⟦{露天|ろてん}{風呂|ぶろ}→露天風呂：14611_rotenburo⟧ (outdoor baths), ⟦サウナ→サウナ：10935_sauna⟧, ⟦{岩盤浴|がんばんよく}→岩盤浴：09832_ganbanyoku⟧ (hot stone baths), restaurants, and relaxation rooms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スーパー{銭湯|せんとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go to a super bathhouse)
- スーパー{銭湯|せんとう}{巡|めぐ}り (super bathhouse hopping)
